repositories.name: Jamesits/dropWPBT
repositories.description: Disables the Windows Platform Binary Table (WPBT) in your UEFI firmware.

repositories.name: pkgw/elfx86exts
repositories.description: Decode binaries and print out which instruction set extensions they use. This program's name is a lie: it supports not just x86/ELF but also ARM64, MachO, and possibly more.

repositories.name: overducast/RiftByte
repositories.description: Binary diff tool for PE (EXE/DLL) and ELF files. Compares two binaries, resolves virtual addresses, decodes x86/x64/ARM instructions, identifies changed sections, and exports a human-readable log and an x64dbg-compatible .1337 patch file. Supports x32, x64, ARM32, ARM64.

repositories.name: vlxlxlv/android-kernel-common-5.10
repositories.description: v1llhaze! GKI Custom Kernel for 5.10 based (android12)

repositories.name: ramabondanp/android_kernel_common-5.10
repositories.description: android common kernel

repositories.name: fzi-forschungszentrum-informatik/riscv-etrace
repositories.description: Decoder and tracer for RISC-V efficient instruction tracing.

repositories.name: malfallah/symrisc
repositories.description: A 32-bit RISC instruction set where the mnemonics are the operators, with a working assembler, disassembler, and signal-level single-cycle CPU simulator.

repositories.name: FISC-Project/FISC-LLVM
repositories.description: FISC - Flexible Instruction Set Computer - Is the new Instruction Set Architecture inspired by ARMv8 and x86-64

repositories.name: yntha/arm64_insn_decoder
repositories.description: Simple project to decode arm64 instructions and display all their encoded fields

repositories.name: 4ad/arm64-dec-gen
repositories.description: Generates arm64 instruction decoding for 7i, the Plan 9 arm64 emulator.

repositories.name: codeswithdev/DEV-OS
repositories.description: 🚀 DevOS is an ambitious open-source initiative to build India’s first fully independent operating system from absolute scratch — including a custom bootloader, kernel, memory management, scheduler, drivers, filesystem, and future AI-native architecture. No wrappers. Built from bare metal.

repositories.name: kobby-pentangeli/lc3box
repositories.description: Assembler, disassembler, virtual machine, debugger, and compiler for the Little Computer 3 (LC-3) assembly language and instruction-set architecture

repositories.name: gpellicci/InstructionSetArchitecture-code-assembler
repositories.description: Definition of a new Instruction Set Architecture and implementation of an assembler and disassembler for an ad-hoc assembly language. Documentation inside

repositories.name: IITian-Ankit/RISCV_5_staged_Pipeline_Core
repositories.description: RISC-V 5-Stage Pipelined Processor implementing the RV32I instruction set in Verilog. Features Instruction Fetch, Decode, Execute, Memory, and Write Back stages, with hazard detection, forwarding, and branch handling for efficient execution.

repositories.name: BengalEmpire/Bengal-Tiger-OS
repositories.description: Bengal Tiger OS is a 32-bit x86 (i386) open-source operating system written in ANSI C and x86 Assembly. Designed with modular architecture, hardware abstraction layers, VBE graphics, FAT filesystem persistence, Realtek network drivers, and a preemptive task scheduler,

repositories.name: mt6768-S/android_kernel_xiaomi_mt6768
repositories.description: mt6768 common kernel

repositories.name: lrqtech/android_kernel_xiaomi_warsaw_lineage24
repositories.description: Android common kernel for Xiaomi warsaw on LineageOS 24.

repositories.name: MattJackson/thumb-asm
repositories.description: An ARM Thumb/Thumb-2 decoder, disassembler, assembler and detour installer in pure safe Rust. Decodes and re-encodes the instruction set against Arm's own architecture reference manuals, relocates instructions, and installs trampolines over live code in a firmware image.

repositories.name: ArianaDadgostar/Instruction-Set-Architecture
repositories.description: This computer architecture program uses 5 projects to use an assembler to translate code into machine language and a disassembler to convert it into source code. It includes an emulator to convert the machine code into action and unit tests to confirm it all works.

repositories.name: BrandonDao/ProjectISA
repositories.description: A C# assembler, disassembler, and emulator for my custom instruction set architecture (work in progress)

repositories.name: VeritasCarpeDiem/Emulator
repositories.description: A assembler, disassembler, and emulator that executes bytecode based on the defined instruction set architecture (ISA)

repositories.name: DaoshuReal/x86-64-decoder
repositories.description: small table-driven x86-64 instruction decoder in C17 with no dependencies, split length/mnemonic and full-operand paths

repositories.name: michalgr/sigstep-a64
repositories.description: Parameterized ARM64 instruction decoder and interpreter in Rust with zero-alloc, async-signal-safe backends.

repositories.name: Daan-25/img4-macos-arm64
repositories.description: A lightweight command-line utility for encoding, decoding, and signing Apple img4 firmware containers, built with support for macOS ARM architecture. Includes source code and build instructions.

repositories.name: wuzw10/arm64-shadow-monitor
repositories.description: ARM64 Shadow Memory Monitor — intercepts store instructions via SIGSEGV and mprotect. Write to read-protected VA_A triggers handler that decodes the instruction and redirects the store to shadow VA_B. Supports STR/STRH/STRB/STP.

repositories.name: MeshacOkello/arm64-simulator
repositories.description: A browser-based ARM64 (AArch64) CPU simulator — instruction decoding, a deterministic cycle-stepped execution engine, and a live view of registers, stack, heap, BSS and rodata.

repositories.name: Anas-Gebreel/riscv-ldpc-cfu-accelerator
repositories.description: RISC-V (NEORV32) custom-instruction accelerator for fixed-point min-sum LDPC decoding on the Terasic DE2-115 (Cyclone IV E).

repositories.name: JignasuShah/riscv-processor
repositories.description: Design and implementation of a 32-bit single-cycle RISC-V processor using SystemVerilog. The project focuses on core datapath components, instruction decoding, control logic, register file design, and ALU operations, with simulation and verification using ModelSim and FPGA development tools.

repositories.name: Pikachu287/RiscV_ISA_Sim
repositories.description: Decoding all RV32I instructions and simulating them

repositories.name: Ruthik85/pipelined-16bit-riscv-core
repositories.description: A 16-bit pipelined RISC-V processor core written in SystemVerilog, featuring modular instruction fetch, decode, and execute stages along with a hazard forwarding unit.

repositories.name: DharanidharanRavikumar/riscv-decoder
repositories.description: A C-based RISC-V RV32I instruction decoder with opcode, register, immediate, and instruction identification support.

repositories.name: DharanidharanRavikumar/riscv-simulator
repositories.description: A from-scratch RV32I instruction-set simulator written in C, It fetches, decodes (using the same match/mask technique as the official Spike simulator), and executes real RISC-V machine code, one instruction at a time.

repositories.name: JorgeGBeltre/EspressoOS
repositories.description: EspressoOS: A from‑scratch operating system for ESP32-S3, written entirely in Rust. A Linux‑inspired kernel (VFS, scheduler, syscalls, everything is a file) with no dependencies on Espressif IDF or Arduino. Includes custom bootloader, memory management, drivers, OTA with A/B slots, and an interactive shell.

repositories.name: sxbari/MyOS-x86
repositories.description: A custom x86_64 operating system built from scratch, featuring a custom kernel, memory management, process scheduling, interrupts, device drivers, filesystem, system calls, and a command-line shell.

repositories.name: aleksandraastojanovic/riscv-kernel
repositories.description: A small operating system kernel for RISC-V (rv64), running on QEMU: custom memory allocator, trap-based system calls, cooperative multithreading with context switching — semaphores, preemptive scheduling and console driver in progress.

repositories.name: Onsase-cpu/Asterion-OS
repositories.description: Asterion is a modular 64-bit operating-system research project for x86-64 PCs. It is designed to make kernel concepts readable while growing toward a complete desktop system: boot, CPU setup, memory, processes, scheduling, system calls, VFS, ASTFS, drivers, networking, security, and user-space tools.

repositories.name: zizadhrmaa/rOSes-are-red_Operating-System
repositories.description: A Unix-like operating system kernel built in C and x86 Assembly, featuring process scheduling, virtual memory, an EXT2 filesystem, device drivers, and an interactive shell. The project showcases low-level systems programming through custom kernel development, hardware interaction, and operating system fundamentals.

repositories.name: sowjithanumola/NovaOS
repositories.description: NovaOS is an open-source x86_64 operating system developed from the ground up. It includes a custom BIOS bootloader, 64-bit kernel, memory management, process scheduler, command-line shell, device drivers, and a modular architecture designed for learning and future expansion.

repositories.name: LDLDL-Android/android_kernel_common
repositories.description: Android common kernel downstream branches for LDLDL-Android devices

repositories.name: SylveonDeko/ack-tegra
repositories.description: Android common kernel for Tegra with Nintendo Switch fixes

repositories.name: suhteevah/linux-compat-nostd
repositories.description: no_std Linux syscall compatibility layer — run Linux binaries on bare metal

repositories.name: jdhruv1503/LinuxCompatibilityLayer
repositories.description: Run Linux syscalls on non-Linux environments — compatibility shim layer

repositories.name: dyber-pqc/bsdulator
repositories.description: FreeBSD binary compatibility layer for Linux — run FreeBSD binaries and jails natively using real-time syscall translation. No VMs, no overhead.

repositories.name: Starry-Old/linux_syscall_api
repositories.description: The project, written by Rust, is a compatibility layer for linux syscalls on different operating systems.
